## packages

```{r}
library(semPower) # v.2.1.1
``` 

## Power analysis

Achieved power to test the hypothesis of close fit based on the root mean square error of approximation (RMSEA; H0: $RMSEA \leq .05$, H1: $RMSEA \geq .05$ at $\alpha = 0.05$) for the specified structural equation models. 

```{r}
# wholebrain SC-Fc coupling (without DE)
ph <- semPower.postHoc(effect = .05, effect.measure = "RMSEA", 
                       alpha = .05, N = 215, df = 34)
#0.59

# frontoparietal SC-Fc coupling
ph <- semPower.postHoc(effect = .05, effect.measure = "RMSEA", 
                       alpha = .05, N = 215, df = 42)
# 0.67

# CD
ph <- semPower.postHoc(effect = .05, effect.measure = "RMSEA", 
                       alpha = .05, N = 215, df = 74)
# 0.86

# SC-FC, CD, intelligence
ph <- semPower.postHoc(effect = .05, effect.measure = "RMSEA", 
                       alpha = .05, N = 215, df = 218)
# 1

summary(ph)
```
